description: 🍪 Chocolate Chip Cookies 7 large cookies ✨ Crispy edges, soft & chewy center, and lots of chocolate! Ingredients: • 115 g salted butter, room temperature (½ cup) • 80 g brown sugar (⅓ cup + 1 tbsp) • 80 g granulated sugar (⅓ cup + 1 tbsp) • 1 egg, room temperature • 180 g all-purpose flour (1½ cups) • 6 g cornstarch (1½ tsp) • ½ tsp baking soda • 4 g salt (¾ tsp) • 100 g chocolate chips (⅔ cup) Method: 1. Beat the butter and sugars for a few minutes until well combined and lighter in color. 2. Add the egg and beat for another few minutes. 3. In a separate bowl, sift and mix the dry ingredients. Add them to the wet ingredients and mix just until combined. 4. Fold in the chocolate chips. 5. Shape the dough into 85–90 g balls (3–3.2 oz each). Chill for a few hours or overnight. 6. Bake at 175°C (350°F) for 12–13 minutes. Right after baking, use a glass or cookie ring to gently shape the edges into perfect circles. Sprinkle with flaky sea salt. 7. Let them cool slightly… and enjoy! 🤎🍪 Save this recipe for your next cookie craving! #chocolatechipcookies #cookierecipe #chocolatecookie #easybaking #creatorsearchinsights
